_meta.data_freshness: Program existence, type, chain/ecosystem, region, and dilution posture are evergreen and verified through June 2026. TIME-SENSITIVE fields (application deadlines, open/closed cohort status, current prize pool / check size, cadence) are baseline snapshots and MUST be re-verified live before the user applies or acts.
_meta.coverage: Global. Every entry is region-tagged. Southeast Asia / Vietnam-relevant entries carry sea_relevant: true.

opportunities.name: a16z Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX)
opportunities.notes: No 2026 cohort has been announced. The program remains active, but check the official page for the next cohort window.

opportunities.name: Alliance DAO
opportunities.notes: Applications for cohort ALL19 (starting Jan 11, 2027) have an early deadline of September 23, 2026 and a regular deadline of November 18, 2026.

opportunities.name: Outlier Ventures Base Camp
opportunities.notes: Accepting applications for late 2026 and early 2027 cohorts on a rolling basis.

opportunities.name: TachyonX (formerly Tachyon Accelerator)
opportunities.notes: Run by Consensys Mesh. Application reviews are paused until Fall 2026.

opportunities.name: YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs)
opportunities.notes: EASY Residency Season 5 applications close September 14, 2026 at 14:59 (GMT+8). The season is 10 weeks, split between online and in-person in Thailand.

opportunities.name: Base Batches Accelerator
opportunities.notes: The official Base accelerator for pre-seed teams. Base Batches 004 applications close September 9, 2026 for the 8-week program.

opportunities.name: Base ecosystem grants (Coinbase / Base)
opportunities.notes: Retroactive grants are awarded on a rolling basis for shipped work on Base. Larger investments are handled by the Base Ecosystem Fund and the Base Batches accelerator.

opportunities.name: Colosseum Eternal (Solana accelerator)
opportunities.notes: The 'Eternal' track is a rolling program for teams who don't want to wait for a hackathon. The next major hackathon is the Fall 2026 edition, running from Sep 28 to Nov 2.

opportunities.name: Draper University Web3 / Crypto programs
opportunities.notes: The Apex Growth Accelerator (Cardano track) has a Sep 1, 2026 deadline. The general Hero Training Fall 2026 session (Oct 11 - Nov 15) is also open for applications.

opportunities.name: Antler (Web3 track)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Pre-seed check (typically equity) after the residency
opportunities.notes: Web3 is a core focus in general residencies. London applications close Sep 22 for the Fall cohort. Singapore intake is Oct 5.

opportunities.name: Founders, Inc. (f.inc)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Space, resources, and investment for some teams
opportunities.notes: The flagship hardware program, Blueprint II, has a deadline of September 14, 2026.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Foundation Ecosystem Support Program (ESP)
opportunities.notes: The ESP has moved away from open intake to a more targeted model with specific RFPs. No open rounds are currently active.

opportunities.name: Arbitrum Foundation Grants
opportunities.notes: The main grant program is active on a rolling basis. Specific initiatives like the Audit Program also accept applications continuously.

opportunities.name: Optimism Grants (proactive)
opportunities.notes: The proactive Grants Council was dissolved in July 2026. Funding now occurs via Foundation-led Missions and a new Strategic Ecosystem Fund. Retro Funding is paused.

opportunities.name: Web3 Foundation Grants (Polkadot / Kusama)
opportunities.notes: The general Grants Program has been discontinued. Builders are routed to the Polkadot Treasury (OpenGov) and Kusama Vision Bounties, which are active and rolling.

opportunities.name: Interchain Foundation Grants (Cosmos)
opportunities.notes: The legacy grants program was archived. On Aug 29, 2026, the ICF announced a new discretionary funding program; details are expected in early September.

opportunities.name: NEAR Foundation Grants / Ecosystem funding
opportunities.notes: Funding has been decentralized to committees and hubs (e.g., Infrastructure Committee, NEAR AI). Applications are accepted on a rolling basis via the funding portal.

opportunities.name: Sui Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Milestone-based grants for Sui ecosystem projects
opportunities.notes: General developer and ecosystem grants are active and reviewed on a rolling basis. Time-sensitive RFPs are also posted periodically.

opportunities.name: Filecoin / Protocol Labs Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Open grants up to $50k and RFPs
opportunities.notes: The main Proactive Public Goods Funding (ProPGF) round for 2026 had its deadline on June 16. The general Open Grants program remains active on a rolling basis.

opportunities.name: ETHGlobal (hackathon series)
opportunities.notes: Upcoming events: ETHOnline (Sep 4-16, deadline Sep 13), ETHGlobal Tokyo (Sep 25-27), ETHGlobal Mumbai (Nov 6-8).

opportunities.name: Colosseum Solana Hackathons (Frontier, etc.)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Large prize pools + $250k investment into top teams
opportunities.notes: The next major event is the Fall 2026 hackathon, running from September 28 to November 2.

opportunities.name: DoraHacks (global hackathon + BUIDL platform)
opportunities.notes: Platform is continuously active with numerous ecosystem hackathons. Deadlines vary by event (e.g., BUIDL CTC 2026 Fall is Sep 13, KeeperHub is Sep 18).

opportunities.name: Polkadot ecosystem hackathons
opportunities.notes: The flagship Polkadot Solidity Hackathon concluded in March 2026. Ecosystem hackathons are now hosted via partners like DoraHacks and Encode Club.

opportunities.name: Gitcoin Grants & Bounties
opportunities.notes: The next major grants round (GG26) is expected in Q4 2026, coinciding with Devcon. Bounties are active and continuous.

opportunities.name: Immunefi (security bug bounties)
opportunities.notes: Continuous bug bounties are active. The next major time-bound event is the ENS Audit Competition, with a submission deadline of September 14, 2026.

opportunities.name: Optimism Retro Funding (RetroPGF)
opportunities.notes: The Retro Funding program is paused for at least 12 months (effective early 2026). The OP Atlas grant platform will be discontinued on Sep 18, 2026.

opportunities.name: Drips (continuous retroactive dependency funding)
opportunities.notes: The protocol enables continuous funding. Specific partner programs have deadlines, e.g., Stellar Wave bounty cycles run monthly; Wave 8 concluded Aug 31, 2026.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Protocol Fellowship (EPF)
opportunities.notes: Applications for the 2026 cohort (EPF7) closed on May 13, 2026. The next intake is expected around Spring 2027.

opportunities.name: Solana ecosystem developer fellowships / bootcamps
opportunities.notes: The Solana School Fall Class (a free, 7-week online program) started on August 31, 2026. Other bootcamps and fellowships run on a rolling basis via partners like Superteam and Encode Club.

opportunities.name: Sky Mavis / Ronin ecosystem grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Ecosystem grants for games/apps on Ronin
opportunities.notes: The main grant programs are rolling. A key deadline is the Axie Classic Bounty Board program, which concludes on September 10, 2026, as the game transitions to community governance.

opportunities.name: Kyros Ventures / Coin98 ecosystem programs
opportunities.notes: The flagship event GM Vietnam 2026 concluded in August. The next major event is Web3 Matching Day in HCMC on Dec 11, with applications closing Nov 30.

opportunities.name: Hashed Emergent (India / SEA)
opportunities.notes: The flagship event, India Blockchain Week, is Nov 1-2 in Mumbai. Demo Day applications are expected to open in October. Direct investment applications are rolling.

opportunities.name: Tribe Accelerator (Singapore)
opportunities.notes: The KUMIHIMO Tech Camp (MedTech) deadline was July 31. The IoT Tribe SG deadline is August 31. The Ignition AI Accelerator is rolling. The main Tribe Accelerator is open for interest.

opportunities.name: sqrDAO builder programs & bounties (Vietnam / SEA)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bounties, hackathon support, and builder programs
opportunities.notes: The BUIDL CTC 2026 Fall hackathon has a deadline of September 7, 2026. Other programs like the sqrBUIDL Accelerator are rolling.

opportunities.name: Superteam Vietnam (Solana)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bounties and grants for Solana builders
opportunities.notes: Bounties and micro-grants are available on a rolling basis via Superteam Earn. Major ecosystem hackathons have specific deadlines throughout the year.

opportunities.name: Corelia Academy (Vietnam Web3 education)
opportunities.notes: UniHackfest 2026 is the main program. The Online National Qualifying Round is September 17-20.

opportunities.name: VBI Academy (Vietnam Blockchain Innovation Academy)
opportunities.notes: The NextX 2026 competition concluded on August 29. Check social media for new developer bootcamp cohorts in late 2026.

opportunities.name: UniHackfest (Vietnam national student hackathon)
opportunities.notes: The national qualifying round is September 17-20, with the Grand Finale on September 26 in HCMC.

opportunities.name: RMIT Vietnam FinTech Club / Hack-A-Venture
opportunities.notes: No announcement for a 2026 edition has been found. The dedicated domain has lapsed.

opportunities.name: HUST BK Fintech Hackday
opportunities.notes: Season 13 (as part of UniHackfest 2026 Hanoi Campus) concluded with its Pitching Day on August 26.

opportunities.name: Vietnam Aptos Hackathon (DoraHacks)
opportunities.notes: This hackathon ran in 2025 and remains closed.

opportunities.name: VietBUIDL Hackathon
opportunities.notes: The last VietBUIDL Hackathon was in 2025. No 2026 edition has been announced.
